reviewed_exclusions.rationale: Retention maintenance has no public request surface; the isolated probe invokes the production transaction against only the world database.
Abandoned-audit reconciliation is scheduled maintenance with no public request surface.
Explicit erasure policy is a production context operation not currently exposed by HTTP or LiveView.
Unsupported-generation validation occurs during application startup and requires an isolated pre-start probe for exact failure evidence.
Deterministic SQLite terminal-write failure injection has no safe public trigger and is limited to the isolated world.
Exhausted terminal-write failure requires deterministic isolated SQLite fault injection and verifies the production retry boundary.
